ACC-001.item: a defaulted store-card balance; the cardholder agreement authorizes only the contract balance and contract interest -- no 'collection charges' or extra fees

ACC-002.item: a defaulted personal loan -- an ordinary civil consumer debt; nonpayment cannot lawfully result in arrest or imprisonment and the collector has no arrest power

ACC-003.item: a charged-off credit-card account; no lawsuit has been filed and no court judgment has been obtained, so wages cannot be garnished and property cannot be liened/seized

ACC-004.item: an old defaulted debt being collected by Sentinel Recovery Group, a debt-collection agency; no attorney and no law firm is involved and none has reviewed the file

ACC-005.item: a bounced check and unpaid balance on a closed account arising from financial hardship; a civil debt -- the consumer has not been charged with or convicted of any crime

ACC-006.item: a debt the consumer has disputed in writing (it may stem from identity theft); Sentinel is aware of the written dispute

ACC-007.item: a debt at INITIAL contact that the consumer does not recognize and has not previously paid; the consumer has asked to dispute it and for written validation

ACC-008.item: a debt the consumer disputed in writing within the 30-day validation period; the collector has not yet mailed any verification

ACC-009.item: a genuine, undisputed credit-card debt the consumer fell behind on; the balance asserted equals the agreement-authorized amount and the debt is well within the statute of limitations (calibration)

ACC-010.item: a genuine but very old debt (about nine years) whose statute of limitations has expired, so it is time-barred -- still validly owed, but it may no longer be sued on (calibration)

ACC-011.item: a genuine, undisputed, in-statute credit-card debt the consumer owes; the collector offered a lawful $75/month payment plan, accurate amount, no threat (calibration)

ACC-012.item: a genuine, undisputed unpaid phone-account balance; an accurate delinquency that may lawfully be reported to the credit bureaus (calibration)

ACC-013.item: a genuine, undisputed, in-statute credit-card debt of $1,450; the collector offered a lawful good-faith settlement of $900 as a one-time lump sum, accurate amount, no threat (calibration)

ACC-014.item: a genuine, undisputed credit-card debt; the balance is principal plus agreement-authorized contract interest that continues to accrue, with no unauthorized fees (calibration)
